headword: {部分|ぶぶん}{月食|げっしょく}

definitions.explanation: A lunar eclipse in which only part of the Moon passes through Earth's main shadow (umbra), darkening a section of its surface.

examples.japanese: {今夜|こんや}は{部分|ぶぶん}{月食|げっしょく}だ。
examples.english: There is a partial lunar eclipse tonight.

examples.japanese: {部分|ぶぶん}{月食|げっしょく}で{月|つき}の{一部|いちぶ}が{欠|か}けて{見|み}えた。
examples.english: Part of the Moon appeared to be missing during the partial lunar eclipse.

examples.japanese: {天気|てんき}が{良|よ}ければ、{今晩|こんばん}の{部分|ぶぶん}{月食|げっしょく}がよく{見|み}えるだろう。
examples.english: If the weather is good, tonight's partial lunar eclipse should be clearly visible.

notes:
Composed of {部分|ぶぶん} (partial) + {月食|げっしょく} (lunar eclipse).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {部分|ぶぶん}{月食|げっしょく}が{見|み}られる: a partial lunar eclipse can be seen
- {部分|ぶぶん}{月食|げっしょく}を{観測|かんそく}する: to observe a partial lunar eclipse

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {皆既|かいき}{月食|げっしょく}: total lunar eclipse — the whole Moon enters Earth's shadow
- {半影|はんえい}{月食|げっしょく}: penumbral eclipse — the Moon only dims slightly
